beats: Bumping carbs up by 15 grams meant tapping a tiny plus button fifteen times.
Swipe a food row by accident and it was simply gone, with no way back.
The only fix was re-adding it and recalculating the whole day's log by hand.
A new JavaScript module lets you scrub a number to its value, like turning a dial.
Now that 15-gram change takes one scrub instead of fifteen taps, and a deleted row returns within 5 seconds.
